purpose: W69 evidence-only whole-cuboid magazine partition recommendation; no production changes.

cuboid_source.index_convention: Zero-based elements[i], verified against name source_volume_NNN; indices are NOT source triangle indices.

method.actual_geometry: Original blend world-space mesh vertices transformed exactly by supplied W30 canonical mapping. All original weapon meshes except Reticle participate in nearest-component comparison.
method.nearest_surface: Bundled Blender BVHTree; compare Magazine BVH with all non-magazine weapon triangles; choose lower Euclidean distance to actual triangle surface. No bbox or component-name vote.
method.face_weighting: Face area / 256 per sample; sample center of each stratum on all six faces. X-min and X-max faces also reported separately to expose overlap hidden by side projection.
method.recommendation_rule: Actual Magazine surface intersects cube (>1e-6 canonical area), Magazine nearest-surface share >=0.60 on all faces AND >=0.60 on X side faces. This is an evidence-backed heuristic for whole cubes, not an exact volumetric partition.
method.surface_intersection: Clip every original Magazine triangle against the 6 cuboid planes; sum clipped 3D triangle areas.
method.side_silhouette: Union of actual projected Magazine triangles rasterized at 512 pixels per canonical unit; fraction of each cube YZ rectangle covered. Ignores X occlusion by design; does not determine ownership.

boundary_definitions.source_surface_intersecting: Positive clipped original Magazine triangle area; actual 3D boundary intersects cube.
boundary_definitions.side_silhouette_boundary_crossing: Projected Magazine coverage between 0.2% and 99.8% of YZ cube rectangle; raster tolerance avoids edge alias noise.
boundary_definitions.mixed_nearest_ownership_over_1pct: Magazine share between 1% and 99% in all-face area-weighted nearest triangle votes.
boundary_definitions.aabb_overhang_axes: Axes on which cube extends outside original Magazine bounding box (not used as an ownership classifier).

recommendation_notes: Recommended whole-cube list has 15 elements. Several cubes retain rounded edge overhang; this is unavoidable without splitting or reconstructing cuboids, outside this sidecar scope.
Keep rejected candidates static: body/trigger-guard region is principally Middle, not Magazine. Source naming does not identify individual trigger or guard geometry, so this is a spatial observation.

Keep cubes 10 and 11 static despite actual Magazine surface intersection: all-face Magazine shares are only about 11.2% and 16.2%; X-side Magazine share is zero. Moving them would move mostly Middle/body material.
Selected mixed ownership cubes 54/64/73/75/139/172/180 have 4.2-24% nearest non-magazine share; see metrics before accepting cosmetic seam tradeoffs.
No selected cube has Fluid or Fluid Glass as a nearest-surface contributor; the fluid window is outside the source Magazine silhouette.
This audit does not author motion, pivots, production partition code, generator changes, runtime resources or gameplay reference claims.
